players.product: Akamai Inference Cloud / cloud infrastructure services (CIS): distributed GPU cloud for AI inference on NVIDIA GPUs, sold on multi-year take-or-pay commitments

quarterly_data.signal: Akamai's 10-Q: remaining performance obligations from contracts with customers were $7.6 billion as of June 30, 2026; Akamai expects to recognize approximately 40% as revenue over the next 12 months and approximately 40% over the next two to three years, with the remainder thereafter.

Akamai's 10-Q (six months ended June 30, 2026): cloud infrastructure services revenue was $193,931 thousand versus $139,064 thousand, up 39%; co-location costs rose 16% to $198,364 thousand and network build-out and supporting services 26% to $141,798 thousand; purchases of property and equipment plus capitalized internal-use software were $417,600 thousand. Akamai says its capital expenditures have increased and it expects them to continue to increase as it invests in expanding cloud infrastructure services, AI capabilities and network capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 CIS revenue $193,931 thousand (+39%); H1 capex incl. capitalized software $417,600 thousand
